verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing site lists "SAML SSO Integration" as a feature, so the product does claim first-party SAML SSO. Nothing in the pack shows how it is configured, whether it can be required or enforced for an organization, or which edition offers it. The community OIDC items describe Gitea acting as an identity provider, which is a different capability, and are not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of SAML configuration, the ability to enforce or require SSO organization-wide (blocking non-SSO logins), clarity on edition or tier availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can require SAML single sign-on for my organization
